'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Michael Thomas DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Thomas]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
